MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Iron rusting

4. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water always increases oxygen

5. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. watt (W)

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Ecology and Ecosystems? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.

7. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish feeds and feeding? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish feeds and feeding.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish feeds and feeding.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish feeds and feeding.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish feeds and feeding.

10. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Reproduction? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Reproduction.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Reproduction.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Reproduction.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Reproduction.

16. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Record keeping in aquaculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Conservation of marine and freshwater environments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
